protocol.immutable_state_scope: after prepare/capture and before/after correctness/timing phases; input/config after every observed replay
protocol.oracle_order: Both separate outputs checked after both timed replays; input/config immediately after each replay
protocol.activity: After all timing; one replay per case/runner; allowlisted names/durations only

limitations: Two shapes, not full official correctness or score
